content.rendered:
Transforming Hopkins Elementary into Administrative Services

In September 2018, our Building Design Committee began meeting to discuss the guiding principles that would inform the design process of the Hopkins building, as it transforms into the new Administrative Services Building in Fall 2020.  Please see links below for information and presentations from those meetings.

Building Design Committee

September 26, 2018

October 3, 2018

October 24, 2018
